request: Items can be listed and created from the items page, but once one is added it can never be removed. Add a DELETE /api/items/:id route that deletes the matching item and responds with no body, or 404 when no item has that id. Put a Delete button next to each item on the items page so a click removes it from the list, cover removal in the API and UI tests, and make sure the app still builds and the API still responds.

plan.goal: Let a user remove an item from the list, both through the API and from the items page.

scope.title: Delete an item through the API and the items page
scope.description: Add a DELETE /api/items/:id handler to the Hono app in src/worker/index.ts that deletes the matching row and responds 204, or 404 when nothing matched. Add a Delete button beside each item in src/pages/Items.tsx that calls the route and drops the item from local state on success. Extend test/api.test.ts and test/app.test.tsx to cover both paths.

steps.description: Add app.delete('/api/items/:id', ...) to src/worker/index.ts above the catch-all asset route, deleting by id with Drizzle and returning 204 on success or 404 when no row matched.
Add a per-item Delete button in src/pages/Items.tsx that issues a DELETE to /api/items/<id> and removes the item from the rendered list when the response is ok.
Extend test/api.test.ts to create an item, delete it, confirm a following list no longer contains it, and confirm deleting a missing id returns 404.
Extend the items-page test in test/app.test.tsx so clicking Delete removes the item from the list, then run the build and both test suites.

out_of_scope.reason: The request is a working delete path; a confirmation step is extra interaction the request does not ask for.

out_of_scope.item: Soft deletion or an undo history
out_of_scope.reason: The table has no deleted-at column; a real delete is the simplest correct behaviour for the request.
